theme: Same-start sounds: the mmm pile and the sss pile

activities.title: Two piles, mmm and sss
activities.intro: Listen to every picture say its name. Some names start with mmm, like moon. Some start with sss, like sun. Put the mmm ones in one pile and the sss ones in the other pile.
activities.offScreen: Go and find something in your house whose name starts with mmm, and something whose name starts with sss, and bring them both to a grown up.

rounds.prompt: Moon, mug, sun, star. Put the mmm ones in one pile and the sss ones in the other pile.
Mountain, stone, moon, star. Put the mmm ones in one pile and the sss ones in the other pile.
Mug, star, mountain, sun, moon, stone. Six of them now. Put the mmm ones in one pile and the sss ones in the other pile.
Moon, square, sun, mug, star, stone. The piles do not have to be the same size. Put the mmm ones in one pile and the sss ones in the other pile.

activities.title: Find the one that starts that way
activities.intro: I will say a sound and stretch it out long. Listen to all the pictures, then tap the one whose name starts with that sound.
activities.offScreen: Say your own name really slowly to a grown up, and stretch the very first sound of it as long as you can.

rounds.prompt: Mmm. Tap the picture whose name starts with mmm.
Sss. Tap the picture whose name starts with sss.
Mmm, like the sound a cow makes. Tap the picture whose name starts with mmm.
Sss, like a snake. Tap the picture whose name starts with sss.

activities.title: One starts a different way
activities.intro: Listen to all four names. Three of them start the same way and one of them does not. Tap the one that starts a different way.
activities.offScreen: Ask a grown up to say three words that start the same way and sneak one different word in, and see if you can catch it.

rounds.prompt: Moon, mug, star, mountain. Tap the one that starts a different way.
Mug, sun, stone, square. Tap the one that starts a different way.
Mountain, moon, mug, sun. Tap the one that starts a different way.
Stone, moon, star, sun. Tap the one that starts a different way.

parentCard.title: The sound-hunt walk
steps: Step outside and announce the hunt before you set off: today we are hunting the mmm sound, and we say it long, mmmm, like a hum.
Find three mmm things together and say each name slowly, stretching the mmm at the front: mud, moss, a mailbox, a motorbike, the moon if it is still up in the daytime.

Stop and ask the why question of the week: a cow says moo, and moo starts with mmm. Why do you think a cow says moo and not something else? Wonder about it together and let their answer be the answer.
On the way home, swap the hunt to sss and find three sss things: sky, stones, steps, a sign, a stick.
At the front door, say their name and then a family member's name very slowly, and ask which sound each one starts with.
notice: Do they stretch the first sound of a word on their own now, or do they still wait for you to stretch it first?
When the hunt swaps from mmm to sss, do they keep bringing you mmm things for a while?
